# Documentation

This folder contains **team-written documentation** for the project, plus the **auto-generated API docs**.

## API documentation (auto-generated)

The API reference is generated by `dartdoc` from Dart doc comments in `lib/`:

```bash
flutter pub get
dart doc --output docs/api
```

When this repo is on GitHub, a workflow deploys the generated site to **GitHub Pages** on every push to `main`.

## Files

- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: high-level structure and data flow
- `DEVELOPMENT.md`: local development notes (env, commands, conventions)
